title: Some Pancreatic Cells Are Just One Genetic Tweak Away From Treating Diabetes
summary: The researchers engineered ductal cells, which—as some previous studies had found—occasionally transform into beta cells all on their own. Through this process, the researchers found that taking out a gene called ALDH3B2 turned ductal cells into beta-like cells at a higher rate.
